notes: Converter module (not an optical transceiver). Power consumption stated as < 5.5W. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Does not include RS (Reed-Solomon) FEC encode/decode; intended for QSFP28 transceivers with interfaces that do not require FEC (e.g. 100GbE ER4/LR4 and OTU4). DDM via MDIO 2-Wire Interface. Safety/regulatory: TUV/UL/FDA (contact Smartoptics), RoHS.
